title: avahi-controller values
description: Values schema for the avahi-controller Helm chart.

global.description: Global values inherited when this chart is used as a subchart.

replicaCount.description: Number of controller replicas. Only one instance may own the hosts file, so values other than 1 are not supported.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull the image from a private registry.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified name of the released resources.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount used by the controller pod.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Generated from the fullname template when empty and create is true.

rbac.description: RBAC resources required to watch Services and emit Events.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the controller pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels added to the controller pod.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context. The controller writes the avahi hosts file on the host, so it runs as root by default.

args.description: Command-line flags passed to the controller binary, e.g. --reload=true or --avahi-service=avahi.service.

env.description: Environment variables for the controller container. NODE_NAME and DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS are set by default.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the controller container.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for pod shutdown, allowing cleanup of the managed hosts block.

volumes.description: Pod volumes. Must provide the avahi hosts file and the D-Bus system socket from the host.

volumeMounts.description: Volume mounts for the controller container. Must mount the avahi hosts file and the D-Bus system socket.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector pinning the controller to the node running avahi-daemon. The pod stays Pending until a node carries these labels.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the controller pod.
